auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.askAdmin: No account yet? Ask the administrator of this server for one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.closed: This server takes no new sign-ups. Ask its administrator for an account.
signUp.existing: Could not sign you in. If you already have an account, sign in instead.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sentAfter: has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works once, for an hour.
forgot.intro: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.incomplete: This reset link is incomplete. Open the link from the mail again, or ask for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.verified: Thank you, your email is confirmed.
verify.resendHint: You can send a new link from the banner in the app.
verify.incomplete: This verification link is incomplete. Open the link from the mail again.
verify.failed: The email could not be confirmed.

verify.before: Please confirm your email: open the link we sent to
verify.resent: A new link is on its way to {{email}}.

mcp.title: AI agents (MCP)
mcp.hintBefore: Agents such as Claude can read and edit your projects through the MCP server at
mcp.hintAfter: . In Claude Code run the command below, then approve the connection in the browser window it opens. In claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector.
mcp.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{name}}? It will need to be authorized again.

password.title: Password
password.google: Your account is linked to Google, so you can also sign in with Google.
password.noneBefore: Your account has no password yet. To sign in with your email too, sign out and choose
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.hint: Deletes your account with all your projects, their versions, files and share links, and your furniture and model library. This cannot be undone.
delete.deleted: Your account and its projects were deleted.

projects.title: Projects

examples.hint: A copy goes into your projects: look around, walk through it, change anything.

projects.importHint: A project file downloaded from a project's page (.izbik.zip or .izbik.json)
projects.emptyExamples: No projects yet. Start from an example above, or draw your own.

project.facade: Façade (exterior walls without a material of their own)
project.downloadHint: A project file with its files and models, to import on another Izbik or keep as a backup
project.withoutFilesHint: The project file without its files and models: plans, photos and product models stay behind
project.confirmDelete: Delete project "{{name}}" with all its floors and versions? This cannot be undone.

floors.title: Floors
floors.lastOne: A project needs at least one floor
floors.name: Floor name
floors.elevationHint: Finished floor level above ±0.000, mm (empty: a new floor stands on the one below, an edited one keeps its level)
floors.slabHint: Slab under the floor, mm (empty: a new floor takes the default, an edited one keeps its slab)
floors.confirmDelete: Delete floor "{{name}}" with everything on it?

versions.title: Versions
versions.empty: No saved versions yet. Save one to keep the current state of all floors.
versions.confirmRestore: Replace the current floors with version {{number}}? The current state is saved as a new version first.
versions.restored: Restored version {{number}}. The previous state is version {{backup}}.

shares.title: Share links
shares.updateHint: Show the floor as it is now (saves a new version, the link stays)
shares.empty: No share links yet. Open a floor and use Share to send a view of it to someone.
shares.confirmUpdate: Update "{{name}}" to the floor as it is now? It saves a new version; the link stays the same.
shares.confirmDelete: Delete the share link "{{name}}"? Anyone who has it loses access. Its version stays.

furniture.title: Furniture
furniture.hint: Custom furniture this project's items can use: global pieces, the owner's library and the project's own. Add them to a floor with the editor's Add menu.

files.title: Files
files.drop: Drop floor plans, renders or photos here

admin.title: Users
admin.added: Added {{name}}. Pass the password on to them; they can change it on their account page.
admin.passwordSet: Set the password of {{name}}; they are signed out everywhere.

oauth.returning: Returning to {{name}}… You can close this window.
oauth.denied: {{name}} did not get access. You can close this window.
oauth.consent: wants to read and edit your projects (floors, rooms, walls, items and versions) on your behalf. Its changes show up under its name and can be undone.
oauth.incomplete: This authorization link is incomplete. Start the connection again from your MCP client.
oauth.unknownClient: Unknown client. Start the connection again from your MCP client.

comments.addTitle: Click a point in the view to pin a comment to it (C)
comments.picking: Click a point in the view…
comments.confirmDeleteThread: Delete this comment and its replies?

views.label: Guest can switch to
views.needsReturn: Allow 3D or Plan: the walk-through needs a view to return to.

camera.switchTo3d: Switch the viewer to 3D and frame the shot first.
camera.none: This link has no saved camera.
camera.hint: Guests start where your camera is now and can return to it.

share.exports: Guests can download the plan, elevations and 3D model
share.expiresHint: Leave empty to keep the link working until you delete it.
share.createHint: Creating the link saves a version of the project: guests see this floor as it is now, later edits do not reach them. The display (ceilings, roof, labels, wall cut, dimensions, electrical symbols, night, sun time, quality, all floors) and the shown variants are kept too.

toasts.noDefinition: There is no furniture definition to use; add one under Furniture.
toasts.noModel: There is no 3D model to use; upload one under Furniture.

panel.pickHint: A grouped item adds its whole group; Shift+click a picked one to drop it, Esc to stop.
panel.turnTitle: Turn by 90° (R, Shift+R the other way)
panel.ungroupTitle: Ungroup: keep the items, drop the group
panel.noItems: No items (add some with an item's Group field).
panel.makeVariantsTitle: Make this group the first of several alternatives (e.g. with / without an island)
panel.editOneHint: Double-click (or Alt+click) one of its items to edit just that one.
panel.variantSetHint: Switch and add variants in the Variants panel. To decide for the shown variant, drop the others with their items (can be undone).

add.wallHint: A 3 m wall where the camera looks; Draw walls (W) draws runs
add.roomHint: A 3 × 3 m room; Room from walls (M) outlines one
add.railingHint: Draw railing (B) draws one along points
add.openingsNote: Select a wall to put a door or window in it.
add.roofHint: A roof over the floor’s walls
add.sectionHint: A cut through the building for the section drawings

draw.arcTitle: Curved walls: each wall waits for its curve (A)
draw.curvePrompt: Move the middle of the wall out, click to fix it, or type its curve
draw.curveLabel: Curve of the wall: how far its middle lies off the straight line, mm, + to the left
draw.nextCorner: Point to the next corner, or type a length
draw.wallLabel: Length of the next wall, mm (optionally <angle in degrees and ~curve in mm)
draw.nextPost: Point to the next post, or type a length
draw.railingLabel: Length of the next stretch of railing, mm (optionally <angle in degrees)
draw.addRoom: Click to add this room · {{area}} m²
draw.pointInside: Point inside walls that enclose a room
draw.keyClose: Click the first point to close

errors.onWall: Inside a wall: click inside a room
errors.open: The walls around here do not close
errors.invalid: The walls around here do not make a usable outline

underlay.showTitle: Show the underlay in the plan view
underlay.clickedApart: Clicked {{distance}} mm apart. How far apart are they really?
underlay.pickPoints: Click two points of a known distance on the plan image (a dimensioned wall, the scale bar).
underlay.calibrateTitle: Set the scale from two points of a known distance
underlay.lay: Lay a plan under the floor…
underlay.traceHint: Trace walls over a scanned floor plan. Calibrate it after placing.
underlay.uploadBefore: Upload a floor plan (PDF, PNG, JPEG) under
underlay.makingImage: Making the page into an image…

dxf.title: Walls from a DXF
dxf.uploadTitle: Upload an ASCII DXF to the project
dxf.chooseLayer: Choose the layer with the walls: two parallel lines 50 to 700 mm apart make a wall.
dxf.intro: Read the walls, doors and windows of a CAD plan saved as an ASCII DXF. All walls come in as interior walls; outline the rooms afterwards with Room from walls.

pdf.which: Which page of {{name}} goes under the plan?
pdf.onlyFirst: Only the first {{shown}} of its {{count}} pages can be laid.

top.shareTip: A link to this floor as shown

levels.label: Floors
levels.caption: Floor
levels.allBelowTip: Show the floors below this one

rooms.empty: No rooms on this floor yet.

card.frontsTip: Or click a front of the selected item

hints.comment: Click a surface to pin a comment there · Esc cancels
hints.plan: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a room to see it
hints.orbit: Drag to orbit · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a room to see it
hints.select: Click to select · Shift+click picks items to group · drag to move, Shift without snapping
hints.drawWalls: Click the centre-line points · type a length (3200) or with an angle (3200<90) · A curves · Enter or Esc ends
hints.detectRoom: Click inside walls to add the room they enclose
hints.drawRailing: Click the railing’s points · double-click ends it · a click on its start closes it

display.frontsTip: Doors and drawers of the cupboards open
display.electricalTip: Lights, sockets and switches, in the plan
display.allBelowTip: Show the floors below this one under it; the floors above are left out
display.traceTip: Trace the walls and rooms of the floor below in the plan
display.lensTip: The camera's lens: a shorter one shows more from the same place, as a wide-angle photo does

share.label: Share link
share.savedAs: Saved as version {{number}}. Manage the project's links on the
share.title: Share this floor

walk.clickToLook: Click the view to look around
walk.padHint: Drag the view to look around · tap a door to open it

toasts.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the link and copy it by hand.
toasts.captureFailed: The view could not be captured.

views.toFilesTip: Save the capture among the project's files

firstSteps.intro: From an empty floor to a walk through it in five steps.
firstSteps.forShortcuts: for all shortcuts. Rather look around a finished one first?

walls.title: Draw the walls
walls.text: Click the corners of the centre line in the plan; type 3200 for an exact length. Enter or Esc ends the run.

rooms.title: Make the rooms
rooms.text: Click inside the walls: the room follows their inner faces and shows its area.

door.title: Put in a door
door.text: Select a wall, then Add → Door (or a window). Drag it along the wall.

furniture.title: Furnish it
furniture.text: Add → Furniture: kitchens, beds, sofas, lights. Drag to place, R turns.

walk.title: Walk through
walk.text: W A S D walks, the mouse looks, E opens a door, Esc ends the walk.

shortcuts.draw: Draw walls · room from walls · railing
shortcuts.door: Open or close the door or cupboard in view
shortcuts.note: Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
shortcuts.notePlan: In the plan, drags snap to the grid and to corners;
shortcuts.notePlanShift: moves in 1 mm steps without snapping. Drag a midpoint of a selected outline for a new corner, double-click a corner to remove it.

measure.firstCalibration: Click the first calibration point on the plan image
measure.first: Click the first point to measure from
measure.snaps: Snaps to wall ends, corners and faces

webgl.lostText: The graphics card was reset or ran out of memory. Reload the page to draw it again.
webgl.missingTitle: This browser cannot show the 3D view
webgl.missingText: Izbik draws with WebGL 2, which is off or missing here. Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser's settings, update the browser and the graphics driver, or try a current Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari.

fields.itemOnGround: Stands on the ground (a sloping plot)
fields.onRoof: Lies on the roof (a solar panel, a vent tile)
fields.sagitta: Curve: middle off the straight line (+ left, 0 straight)
fields.heightEnd: Height at the end (empty: level top)
fields.wallOnGround: Stands on the ground (a garden wall on a slope)
fields.leafWidth: Leaf width (the hinge leaf of a double door)
fields.side: Side (swing; sliding: hangs on; window: interior; niche: cut into; garage: inside)
fields.sillBoard: Sill board (reach past the interior wall face)
fields.inset: Frame in from the outer face (empty: centred)
fields.revealLining: Line the reveal with the façade
fields.groundLevel: Ground level (+ above, − below the floor)
fields.ownRise: Own rise (garden steps; empty: to the next floor)
fields.firstFlight: Risers up to the landing (empty: half)
fields.liningDepth: Lining depth (empty: to the ceilings below)
fields.downpipes: Downpipes [{edge: Front | Back | Left | Right, along}] (JSON, empty: at the corners)
fields.alongRidge: Along the ridge (from the roof centre)
fields.slabSoffit: Slab soffit where it overhangs (empty: façade)

stairStep.one: {{count}} riser of {{riser}} mm over {{rise}} mm; 2R + G = {{rule}} mm
stairStep.few: {{count}} risers of {{riser}} mm over {{rise}} mm; 2R + G = {{rule}} mm
stairStep.other: {{count}} risers of {{riser}} mm over {{rise}} mm; 2R + G = {{rule}} mm

fields.ridgeHint: Underside {{height}} m above the floor at the ridge
fields.ridgeHintShed: Underside {{height}} m above the floor at the top edge

custom.unavailable: The furniture definition is not available.

bands.none: Painted walls, no tiles or panelling.
bands.roomHint: This face takes the bands of the room in front of it.
bands.bareHint: This face stays bare, whatever the room has.

points.outlineHint: mm. In the top view drag the corners; drag a midpoint for a new one, double-click one to remove it.

spots.empty: Flat. Double-click the plot's ground in the top view to add a spot height.
spots.hint: mm; height against the floor's level. Drag a spot in the top view, double-click to add or remove one.

lights.title: Lights
lights.pickHint: Click lights in the view to link or unlink them
lights.pickTitle: Pick the lights this switch controls (L)
lights.hint: Lights on this floor only. A light linked to two switches is two-way switching.
